name: mycrew
description: mycrew — a five-layer harness for Claude Code, each layer built on the one below. 1) mycrew-tools gives you the primitives and the house rules. 2) mycrew-pipeline is the build pipeline that carries a task from a decision to hardened code. 3) mycrew-setup prepares a repo: features, specs, architecture. 4) mycrew-worker is the second pilot that drives setup and pipeline on one project. 5) mycrew-chief is the top brain that orchestrates workers across a product's sub-projects. Install mycrew-tools first.

plugins.name: mycrew-tools
plugins.description: Layer 1/5 — primitives. Small, project-agnostic skills you or the model reach for while working: /slap resets a stuck fix, /likec4 draws C4 architecture-as-code, /reminder pins one rule file as a hard constraint, /retract hunts down information declared wrong and surgically removes it. Also ships the harness's rule files (rules/) to copy into a project's .claude/rules/. The primitives every layer above builds on.

plugins.name: mycrew-pipeline
plugins.description: Layer 2/5 — the build pipeline. Five stage skills that carry one task from a decision to hardened code: /how-to-do (decide a fork), /do (build it by a tight set of writing rules), then /refactor, /review, /test to harden and ship it. Skills only. Built on mycrew-tools; driven by mycrew-worker.

plugins.name: mycrew-setup
plugins.description: Layer 3/5 — repo preparation. The skills that ground a repo before any build: feature-management (the declarative features and notes in docs/features/), architecture-management (the model.c4 tree in docs/architecture/), spec-management (detailed specs in docs/specs/ — placeholder). Plus one interview that fills them all: /setup draws everything out of the human and files each piece where it lives. Built on mycrew-tools; driven by mycrew-worker.

plugins.name: mycrew-worker
plugins.description: Layer 4/5 — the second pilot. Hand /worker any piece of work (a fix, a change, a feature, a question) and it adapts: reads the goal (features) and design (architecture), then drives the right mycrew-setup, mycrew-pipeline, and mycrew-tools skills to finish it. Runs inline as /worker or as a native subagent you delegate a whole task to. Built on mycrew-setup + mycrew-pipeline + mycrew-tools.

plugins.name: mycrew-chief
plugins.description: Layer 5/5 — the top brain. /chief (backed by the chief-rules skill) orchestrates the workers across a product's sub-projects, each its own git repo under the current folder. It owns the product plane — the product-wide features of cross-cutting capabilities (features-management), direction finding (what-to-do), and the product CLAUDE.md (via /chief-init) — keeps each repo's features true, and sequences and dispatches workers (as native subagents) where cross-repo work needs them. It conducts; the workers build. Built on mycrew-worker.
